summary: US-Iran war enters final stages as Trump claims Iran desperately seeks agreement while IRGC attacks US-bound vessel near Hormuz. US House passes broad sanctions on Russia and Iran; tanker fleet shows 23-aircraft drawdown from non-CENTCOM bases. IDF conducts targeted arrests in Jenin and Gaza strikes killing three militants.
key_points: IRGC attacked US-bound ship near Strait of Hormuz with 4 drones and at least 1 missile, causing minor injuries including smoke inhalation (Source: @kianmeli1/92123).
US tanker fleet reduced by 23 aircraft at orange/green bases since 11 Sept, suggesting partial drawdown outside CENTCOM (Source: @shin_persian/10082).
US House passed Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act 262-159, sent to Trump for signature (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7191).
Dabura unit arrested Mohammad Saadi, senior PIJ-affiliated terrorist in Jenin, directed by Shin Bet (Source: @yediotnews25/135050).
Three Hamas and PIJ operatives killed in Gaza strikes, including Hamas Daraj-Tuffah Battalion commander (Source: @shin_persian/10075).
Trump to meet Gulf leaders at UN General Assembly Tuesday to discuss post-war Iran strategy (Source: @mamlekate/104511).
IDF on high alert for Hamas retaliation including possible kidnapping after recent Gaza killings (Source: @pkpoi/143961).

sections.executive_summary: The US-Iran conflict approaches its final phase as Trump asserts Iran desperately wants an agreement while IRGC forces attack American-linked shipping near Hormuz. Congressional sanctions on both Russia and Iran advance to Trump's desk as tanker repositioning suggests force redistribution. Simultaneously, IDF conducts targeted counterterrorism operations in Jenin and Gaza, raising concerns of Hamas retaliation.
iran: IRGC attacked a US-contract ship carrying American forces near Strait of Hormuz using 4 Iranian drones and at least 1 missile; one projectile struck the vessel causing minor injuries including smoke inhalation. Tensions remain high over this vital shipping route (Source: @kianmeli1/92123).
IRGC Ground Forces commander visited Gulf islands, stating Iranian armed forces will confront any enemy miscalculation with force, supported by the Iranian people (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392483).

IRGC spokesperson Akrami dismissed claims of Iranian military destruction as false, warning the US would face a more decisive and widespread response if it attacks again (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392485).

Political prisoner Abu al-Fadl Qadianian in Evin Prison denied Islamic Republic claims about foreign-linked terrorists killing Dey 1404 protesters, blaming government forces for the massacre and naming Khamenei and son Mojtaba as responsible (Source: @VahidOnline/78414).

Hussein Qeshqa'i, wife Sara Shamsai, and brother Abu al-Fadl Qeshqa'i arrested Thursday by Intelligence Ministry in Lahijan, transferred to Raja; devices seized during raid. Hussein faces charges including propaganda against regime and incitement (Source: @VahidOnline/78410).
Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi in Beijing welcomed diplomatic solutions ensuring Iranian rights, ahead of Xi-Trump meetings where Iran war expected as key topic (Source: @mamlekate/104511).
Iran Intelligence Ministry condemned assassination of Sunni scholar Molavi Yousef Gorgij, stating terrorism cannot silence unity (Source: @presstv/207094).
israel: Dabura unit arrested Mohammad Saadi, senior terrorist in Jenin terrorist organization dismantled in Operation Iron Wall, affiliated with PIJ, managing funds for attacks on IDF and civilians, under Shin Bet direction (Source: @yediotnews25/135050).

IDF combat fitness branch established for reservists including heavy weight carrying, prolonged maneuvering, casualty evacuation under fire, from home training to field qualification tests (Source: @idf_telegram/25141).
Eisenkot firmly opposed to rotation government and alternate PM concept, stating PM should be elected for full 4 years to implement domestic and regional plans (Source: @amitsegal/64960).
Lieberman declared no government with Ra'am, urging followers to stay updated (Source: @pkpoi/143958).
Netanyahu vowed to revoke citizenship of those who disgrace IDF soldiers, in response to NZ film controversy (Source: @amitsegal/64946).
Eisenkot met with Bedouin council head Weserlof, declaring support for Jewish strength and rejecting Ra'am (Source: @amitsegal/64951).
IDF preparing for possible Hamas retaliation including kidnapping attempts following recent Gaza operational successes (Source: @pkpoi/143961).
gaza_west_bank: Three Hamas and PIJ operatives killed in Israeli strikes: Saeed Asaad Saeed Akrim, Hamas Daraj-Tuffah Battalion commander, in Gaza City; Nimer Arshi, PIJ rocket launcher, and Ahmad Shaer, Hamas Shejaiya Battalion explosive device planter, in northern Gaza (Source: @shin_persian/10075).

Dabura unit conducted special operation in Burkin, Menashe brigade, arresting Mohammad Saadi affiliated with Jenin terrorist organization dismantled in Operation Iron Wall, under Shin Bet direction (Source: @New_security8200/203815).
IDF states forces will continue proactive and offensive counterterrorism operations across Judea and Samaria division to maintain civilian security (Source: @New_security8200/203815).
Three militants killed while 'systematically violating ceasefire' and advancing attacks, removed as threat per IDF statement (Source: @shin_persian/10075).
lebanon: Israel reported active in Lebanon as part of broader regional operations, according to Arab sources briefing on Israeli military activity across multiple theaters (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392479).
Limited specific operational data available in current message set regarding Lebanon front developments.
syria_iraq: Smoke columns observed on Palestine Street in Baghdad, indicating possible security incident (Source: @naya_foriraq/90742).
Artillery shelling reported in Damascus countryside per live map (Source: @redlinkleb/43426).
Israel active in Syria as part of regional operations, briefed to Arab allies (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392479).
gulf_states: Trump to meet Gulf leaders Tuesday at UN General Assembly in New York to discuss next steps in Iran war and post-war strategy (Source: @mamlekate/104511).

US reportedly helping Saudi Arabia establish alternative oil export route bypassing Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz, leveraging intelligence cooperation beyond military bases and Aramco pipeline (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392479).
IRGC Ground Forces commander visited Gulf islands, asserting readiness to confront enemy miscalculations (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392483).
key_developments: IRGC attacked US-bound vessel near Strait of Hormuz with 4 Iranian drones and at least 1 missile; one hit caused minor injuries including smoke inhalation, escalating tensions over this vital shipping route (Source: @kianmeli1/92123).

US tanker fleet reduced by 23 aircraft at orange/green bases since 11 September as CENTCOM numbers held steady, suggesting partial drawdown or redirection of supporting forces outside CENTCOM (Source: @shin_persian/10082).

US House passed Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act 262-159, imposing sanctions on Russia's shadow fleet, up to 100% tariffs on top 5 Russian energy buyers, extending Iran Sanctions Act 1996; sent to Trump (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7191).

Dabura unit arrested Mohammad Saadi, senior PIJ-affiliated terrorist in Jenin terrorist organization dismantled in Operation Iron Wall, under Shin Bet direction, for managing funds for attacks on IDF and civilians (Source: @yediotnews25/135050).

Three Hamas and PIJ operatives killed in Gaza: Hamas Daraj-Tuffah Battalion commander Akrim in Gaza City, PIJ rocket launcher Arshi and Hamas Shejaiya Battalion member Shaer in northern Gaza, all violating ceasefire (Source: @shin_persian/10075).

Trump to meet Gulf leaders Tuesday at UN General Assembly in New York for post-war Iran strategy discussions; post-war plan being drafted by Trump team expected after midterms (Source: @mamlekate/104511).
IDF on high alert for Hamas retaliation including possible kidnapping attempts and rocket fire following recent Gaza operational successes against militants (Source: @pkpoi/143961).
sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC attack on a US-bound vessel near Hormuz with 4 drones and a missile signals continued Iranian asymmetric capability despite heavy losses claimed by Trump. The IRGC spokesperson's warning of a more decisive response to any further US attack indicates escalation risk remains high. Simultaneously, IDF counterterrorism operations in Jenin and Gaza create immediate retaliation threats from Hamas and PIJ, with kidnapping scenarios now factored into IDF readiness planning. The convergence of US-Iran diplomatic maneuvering and military pressure creates an unpredictable operational environment in the coming days.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are being engaged by Trump for post-war strategy discussions at the UN, with Saudi Arabia reportedly receiving US intelligence cooperation and assistance establishing alternative oil export routes bypassing Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb. Iran's FM in Beijing signals openness to diplomatic solutions ensuring Iranian rights ahead of Xi-Trump meetings. Arab sources indicate Israel's regional activities in Syria, Lebanon, Gaza, West Bank, and Yemen are being briefed to Gulf partners, suggesting expanding intelligence coordination that may lead to Saudi participation in some form of Abraham Accords-type arrangement.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 23-aircraft drawdown from non-CENTCOM bases while CENTCOM numbers remain steady suggests force redistribution rather than overall reduction, possibly indicating preparation for other operational needs or a shift in supporting infrastructure. Helmet camera documentation from Dabura unit operations in Menashe brigade confirms Shin Bet-directed arrests in Jenin, demonstrating continued intelligence-led counterterrorism coordination. Political prisoner testimonies from Evin Prison alleging government responsibility for Dey 1404 killings and naming Khamenei personally may indicate internal regime fractures being exploited in information warfare. Flight cancellations and delays to Tehran from Mashhad suggest ongoing operational disruptions to Iranian civil aviation.
